intro.text: A Shin monastery dedicated to Talmut, overlooking the Nirovah Valley from a rocky ridge.

description.text: The fortified great hall has cages of gemstones open to the highstorms. A mural of Talmut covers its floor.
A winding path connects the monastery to a soldiers' camp along the ridge.
The Farmer, General and Cook govern the surrounding Encilo region while carrying out the work their titles describe.

items.text: After Szeth killed a soldier during an attack on his family's homestead, he was required to train at the monastery. His family moved there with him.
Neturo became the General's aide and helped reform the camp, improving its organization and morale.
When Szeth became a shaman acolyte, he and Neturo left for the Elsecaller monastery and Mokdown.
The soldiers left after hearing a voice, and nearby villagers moved into the camp. They feared the soil would swallow anyone who stepped outside by day.
Szeth fought Rit in the great hall and recovered the Stoneward Honorblade. Their battle left the floor lowered and its mural broken into pillars.
The camp's residents emerged from their houses after the fight and thanked Szeth for freeing them.
